observations: Full numbered source overlay and all 27 small-component crops inspected. Sixteen isolated acute tips excluded explicitly. Retain the 23-pixel eye highlight, the two small mouth spaces above the middle divider and the five-pixel enclosed triangle beside them. Reconnect six fragments of the thin right hair curl, keeping the adjacent broader hair strand separate. Reconnect the two fragments of a small closed leaf-stem detail near the lower center. Face and upper hair are continuous with open facial contours; separate eye whites/highlights, brow panes and forehead curls remain. Horizontal middle divider splits the upper head and lower beard panel; beard curls and their closed inner spaces remain distinct. Flame-like upper forms and broad leaf/stem shapes retain enclosed vein panes and open vein strokes. Names follow upper symbols, head/beard and surrounding leaves. No canonical pixels or earlier saved versions changed.
